text:
Maya (Finance Ops): Heads up — we just received a batch of APAC partner invoices and one large SGD invoice arrived after our cutoff. Close is EOD PST tomorrow. Do we accrue or push to next period?

Josh (Revenue Ops): Which partner/how much? Any signed SOW that covers Mar?

Maya (Finance Ops): Partner = CloudRack APAC (contract 2024-AC-77). Invoice SGD 32,400 dated 2026-03-31 but received 2026-04-01 09:12 SGT. Our cutoff was 23:59 UTC on Mar 31 so it missed by arrival time. It's for a committed Dedicated capacity prepay that covers Mar.

Audrey (Accounting): If the underlying obligation was satisfied in Mar and the service period covers Mar, standard practice is to record an accrual for unbilled revenue at month-end. Proposed JE (create in local currency and translate):
```
DR Accrued Revenue — SGD 32,400
CR Deferred Revenue — SGD 32,400
Memo: Accrual for CloudRack APAC invoice received post-cutoff (contract 2024-AC-77). Reverse in Apr when invoice posts.
```

Leo (FP&A): Agree with accrual treatment. Use spot rate 0.72 SGD->USD for preliminary close P&L mark; run FX reval in Apr and document sensitivity. Please tag the contract in the JE so we can trace to commit schedule. :white_check_mark:

Josh (Revenue Ops): @Audrey can you post the accrual and set reversal date Apr 05? Also include copy of the invoice scan and contract id in the journal. If legal says anything different we'll adjust.

Audrey (Accounting): Will do. Posting tonight and will add supporting docs to the close package. Reversal Apr 05 set.

close-bot: Ticket CLOS-4821 created and assigned to Audrey (Accounting) for accrual posting and docs.

Maya (Finance Ops): Thanks team — please also note any customer billing disputes (none flagged yet) and mark in the close notes. I'll include a short line in the revenue schedule about this post-cutoff accrual. :memo:
